description: Sportily helps users discover horse-racing cards, SmartPicks, Value Finder candidates, Race Lens matches, runner profiles, race context, post-race results, and their personal My Picks tracking data through ChatGPT. The app supports access-gated workflows for finding races and horses, analysing race cards, comparing runners, backtesting saved filters, and saving or reviewing private tracked picks.
